name: Claims Hub · 1 · Intake, routing & human review

parameters.content:
## 1 · Intake
`POST /webhook/claims-hub/intake`
AI triage result from the claims assistant.

## 2 · Validate
Schema check, sanity check, duplicate check.
Bad input -> 422, duplicate -> 409, impossible amount -> error workflow.

## 3 · Enrich
Sub-workflow **Risk & SLA engine**: risk score, priority, due date.

## 4 · Router
One lane per recommended next step.

## Lane A · Fast track
Small, low-risk, covered claims are queued for payout.
Anything else falls back to an adjuster.

## Lane B · Adjuster
Sub-workflow **Assign adjuster** (round robin), task + notification.

## Lane C · Missing information
Respond now, then **wait** until the customer completes a form.

nodes.name: Section · Lane D · Possible exclusion -> human decision

parameters.content:
## Lane D · Possible exclusion -> human decision
The AI never rejects. A handler decides in a form; the execution waits.

## 5 · Close
Collect lanes A+B, log, count time saved, respond 201.
